dialogue.title: NVIDIA Investment Decision for Acme Trust
dialogue.question: Should Acme Investment Trust add NVIDIA (NVDA) by trimming the existing NVAI position?

tensions_resolved.label: Conviction vs Diversification Paradox
tensions_resolved.resolution: Swap = reshuffling, not diversification. AI-for-AI doesn't reduce risk.

tensions_resolved.label: Tax Efficiency vs Strategic Rationale
tensions_resolved.resolution: Cash deployment or no action both eliminate ~$4,300 tax drag.

tensions_resolved.label: Position Sizing Methodology
tensions_resolved.resolution: If proceeding: 5-7% via DCA, cash-funded. If not: zero.

tensions_resolved.label: ESG Coherence
tensions_resolved.resolution: If ESG matters, trim PETX/DFNS (D/F rated); if not, irrelevant.

tensions_resolved.label: Valuation Timing
tensions_resolved.resolution: 58x P/E stretched; no action now, revisit on pullback to $700-750.

rounds.summary: Unanimous skepticism toward the proposed NVAI->NVDA swap. Key concerns: false diversification, tax drag, position sizing incoherence, ESG inconsistency.
Three tensions resolved (T01, T02, T04). New tension emerged: valuation timing at 58x P/E. Decision hierarchy proposed.
All tensions resolved. 5/8 experts converged. Split on 'pure wait' vs 'set limit orders' recognized as operational preference.

grounds: False diversification - Both positions AI-correlated with shared TSMC dependency
Tax inefficiency - ~$4,300 drag on realized NVAI gains
ESG inconsistency - Trimming A-rated NVAI while holding D/F-rated PETX/DFNS

conditional_recommendation.implementation: Either pure waiting OR pre-set limit-order ladder acceptable

verdict.default_action: No action. Hold current portfolio. Cash remains dry powder.

key_perspectives.label: NVAI as optionality premium
key_perspectives.content: 67.6% winner with asymmetric upside; trimming sacrifices optionality

key_perspectives.label: Tax drag quantification
key_perspectives.content: ~$4,300 tax drag from swap vs zero from cash deployment

key_perspectives.label: TSMC single point of failure
key_perspectives.content: Both NVDA and NVAI share TSMC dependency; swap doesn't diversify

key_perspectives.label: Cycle timing risk
key_perspectives.content: 58x P/E prices in Blackwell perfection with no margin for error

key_perspectives.label: AI capex ROI inflection risk
key_perspectives.content: Enterprise ROI on generative AI remains thin; capex could pause

key_perspectives.label: Regret aversion asymmetry
key_perspectives.content: Active sell decision creates 2-3x worse regret than passive omission

key_perspectives.label: Funding source clarity
key_perspectives.content: Cash deployment is obvious alternative; ESG laggards logical trim targets
